title: Proposed SNAP cuts would mean more hungry children
summary_en: The Trump administration last week announced a proposed policy shift for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program that could strip benefits from millions. The change would devastate families already struggling due to updated eligibility rules, said Stephen Roll, at the WashU Brown School.

title: PAD presents ‘Top Girls’ Nov. 19-22
summary_en: Five exceptional women from history, folklore, literature and art gather for dinner. In “Top Girls,” British playwright Caryl Churchill explores gender, social expectation and definitions of success. WashU’s Performing Arts Department will present the celebrated drama Nov. 19-22.
